findings.affected_task: Audit a review that fails native completion validation or host result validation.
findings.contract: Native receipts and failure diagnostics remain separate host records; execution failures may carry an EnforcementReceipt.
findings.problem: When the executor raises OperationExecutionError with a receipt, the exception handler persists only the error code and message, discarding the receipt. Likewise, when execution returns successfully but subsequent result or freshness validation fails, the available execution result is omitted. The saved execution record therefore contains no native attestation for either failure. Reproduce with an executor that raises the contracted error with a populated receipt, or returns a completion whose review input identity is rejected. Preserve the available receipt or execution result in the private failure record so the failed review remains auditable.
